subject.title: docs cat drops internal link targets on text runs (link.tabId / bookmarkId / headingId) in all output modes; readable only via --raw

question: Should this issue be narrowed to unambiguous `TabId` rendering plus structured metadata, or should one implementation also define deep-link resolution for `BookmarkId` and `HeadingId`?
rationale: The tab URL format has an existing precedent, but bookmark and heading identifiers need a deliberate resolution and output contract rather than guessed URLs.

options.title: Narrow to tab links
options.body: Implement `TabId` Markdown rendering and preserve all internal identifiers in structured JSON, tracking resolved bookmark and heading links separately if needed.

options.title: Define every internal link
options.body: Keep one issue open until URL synthesis and target-tab rules are specified and tested for tabs, bookmarks, and headings.

recommendation.title: Narrow to tab links
recommendation.body: Implement `TabId` Markdown rendering and preserve all internal identifiers in structured JSON, tracking resolved bookmark and heading links separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Docs release ownership makes this person the best available router for the output-contract and sequencing decision.
